senses.gloss:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Muddy, clayey.
E.
स for सह, with जम्बाल mud.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Watery, wet.
E.
स with, जल water.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Of the same sort or species, of the same tribe, &c.
m. (-तिः)
The son of a man and woman of the same caste.
E.
स for समान same, and जाति species.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Descended from parents of the same tribe or caste.
2 Of the same tribe.
3 Of the same species.
4 Like, similar.
E.
स for समान same, जाति sort, kind, and छ aff.

mfn. (-जूः-जूः-जुः)
Associated, an associate or companion.
ind. (-जूः)
With, together with.
E.
स with जुष to please, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं)
1 Armed, accoutred.
2 Fortified.
3 Prepared, got ready.
4 Ornamented, decorated.
5 Covered, clothed.
f. (-ज्जा)
1 Dress, decoration.
2 Armour, mail.
E.
षस्ज to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Of good family, well born.
2 Respectable, reputable.
3 Good, virtuous.
4 Arming, putting on armour.
5 Dressing, preparing.
n. (-नं)
1 A guard, a sentry, a picquet.
2 A ferry, a Ghāt.
f. (-ना)
1 Caparisoning an elephant.
2 Dress, decoration.
3 Arming, accoutring.
E.
षस्ज to go, aff. युच्, or सत् excellence, जन a person.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Arming.
2 Dressing.
3 Getting ready, preparing.
4 Hesitating, (in speech.)
E.
षस्ज to go, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Armed, accoutred.
2 Dressed, decorated, ornamented.
3 Prepared, made.
E.
सज्जा armour, इतच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Arming, arraying, preparing, decorating.
E.
सज्ज armed, and करण् making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Armed, accoutred, prepared, decorated.
E.
सज्ज, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Armed, prepared, decorated.
E.
सज्ज, and भूत become, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
Strung, (as a bow,) having a bowstring.
E.
स with ज्या a bowstring.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Recovered after insensibility, become sensible.
2 Having a name or denomination.
E.
सज्ञा sign, name, &c., मतुप् aff.

m. (-यः)
An epithet or attributive.
E.
सज्ञा, and विषय object.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Called, denominated.
E.
सज्ञा, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-ज्ञुः-ज्ञुः-ज्ञु)
Knock-kneed.
E.
सम् together, and ज्ञु for जानु the knee.
